entry.LONG: exact M1 bid open plus exact M1 spread times 0.01

touch_side.SHORT: M1 ask high and low reconstructed as bid high or low plus contemporaneous spread times 0.01

time_exit.eligible_bar: M1 bar-open is strictly before wall-clock horizon so its close is at or before horizon
time_exit.SHORT: last eligible M1 ask close reconstructed from bid close plus spread

cost_application: Outcome and base_r use actual bid/ask path. Strong and extreme R subtract only incremental spread beyond actual plus adverse entry and exit slippage.
snapshot_end_rule: A TARGET or PROTECTIVE hit before snapshot end is resolved. A no-hit row whose horizon extends past the last observed M1 close is UNRESOLVED and excluded.

gap_fill_rule.protective: If an eligible M1 bar opens beyond the protective level, fill at the adverse bid open for LONG or reconstructed ask open for SHORT.
gap_fill_rule.target: If an eligible M1 bar opens beyond the target level without a protective gap, fill at the target level.
gap_fill_rule.intrabar: When neither boundary is crossed at the open, use M1 high/low and resolve same-M1 collisions as PROTECTIVE.
